solution.title: Clinical Synthetic Data Generation Harness (Realistic, Privacy-Conscious EHR Data)

products.name: Clinical Synthetic Data Generation Harness (Realistic, Privacy-Conscious EHR Data) — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a clinical synthetic data generation harness — realistic, privacy-conscious EHR records against FHIR/OMOP/native, with scenarios and reproducibility — so AI/QA get high-fidelity test data safely. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Generate realistic clinical data without touching real PHI

AI and QA teams need realistic clinical data to test against — but real EHR data carries privacy risk they can't take on. This solution builds a clinical synthetic data generation harness: generate clinically plausible, privacy-conscious synthetic records (patients, encounters, conditions, medications, labs, vitals) against a target model (FHIR/OMOP/native), with configurable scenarios and reproducibility — so teams get high-fidelity test data safely.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python tooling.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the synthetic clinical-data model: target standard (FHIR/OMOP/native), generation approach, clinical plausibility, reproducibility, and the privacy-conscious posture.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Python environment, target data model, isolated environment, privacy stakeholders, reference stats).
  • Implementation Guide — design the generation harness (entities, relationships, distributions, scenarios), generate a pilot dataset, validate clinical plausibility, and expand coverage.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
  • Testing/validation gates (schema-valid, plausible, reproducible) plus Best Practices for a maintainable, extensible harness.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Realistic clinical test data on demand — clinically plausible, reproducible, and privacy-conscious — so AI and QA teams evaluate safely without real PHI.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • generate_harness.py — seeded, reproducible synthetic-EHR generator (dry-run by default)
    • plausibility_report.py — grade a synthetic dataset for clinical plausibility and coverage
    • scenario_config.py — scaffold, edit, and validate the harness config + scenario suite
    • schema_privacy_validator.py — validate schema conformance and privacy of a synthetic-EHR dataset
    • scope_assessment.py — profile target model, in-scope domains, reference coverage, and out-dir safety

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
